extracted.intended_audience: IP office statisticians, policymakers, trademark researchers, and analysts
extracted.subtask_description: Analysis and reporting of trademark application and registration statistics across offices, origins, Nice classes, industry sectors, and procedural indicators (2021). Focuses on class counts, registrations in force, office performance measures, oppositions, appeals and related ratios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flows of non-resident trademark application class counts between selected top origins and offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of non-resident trademark application classes flowing from top origin countries to selected offices (absolute application class counts rather than equivalents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. The office and origin data shown consist of absolute rather than equivalent application class counts. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of trademark application class counts for the top 15 offices and selected non-resident origins, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage distribution of application class counts by office, broken down by non-resident origin for the top 15 offices and selected origins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Figures based on non-resident filing data from 137 IP offices. Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of non-resident trademark applications by top Nice classes, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Ranking of top Nice classes among non-resident trademark application class counts (shows class number, description and share %).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example top classes listed (with descriptions) such as Class 9 (Scientific, photographic, measuring instruments; computers and software), Class 35 (Advertising, business management), etc. Figures based on non-resident filing data from 137 IP offices. See www.wipo.int/classifications/nice for full list and class definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-resident trademark applications by goods and services classes, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of non-resident trademark application class counts between goods classes (first 34 classes) and services classes (remaining 11 classes) in the 45-class Nice Classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: In the 45-class Nice Classification, the first 34 classes indicate goods and the remaining 11 refer to services. These figures are based on non-resident filing data from 137 IP offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-resident trademark applications by industry sector, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of non-resident application class counts across defined industry sectors (e.g., Research and technology, Health, Clothing and accessories, etc.) and their shares (%) of total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Industry sectors based on Nice class groups as defined by WIPO/Edital; see annex B for full definitions and composition of Nice goods and services classes. Figures based on non-resident filing data from 137 IP offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark applications by top three sectors at the top offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: For selected top offices, the share (%) of trademark application class counts represented by the top three industry sectors (visualized as a bar chart).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top three sectors and top offices were selected based on 2021 totals. Some sectors abbreviated. See www.wipo.int/classifications/nice for class listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of trademark applications by goods and services at the top offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Share (%) of services classes versus goods classes among application class counts for top offices (shows variation in services share across offices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark applications by top three sectors for the top origins, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: For leading origin countries, the share (%) of application class counts in their top three industry sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Industry sectors based on class groups defined by Edital. Top three sectors and top origins were selected based on 2021 totals. See annex B for full definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resident trademark application class count per USD 100 billion GDP for selected origins, 2011 and 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application class counts normalized per USD 100 billion (2017 PPP) GDP for selected origin countries, compared between 2011 and 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: GDP data are in 2017 US purchasing power parity (PPP) dollars. Selected origins included if GDP > USD 25 billion PPP and resident trademark application class count >= 100. Figure is a selection across regions and income groups. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resident trademark application class count per million population for selected origins, 2011 and 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application class counts normalized per million population for selected origins, compared between 2011 and 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected origins included if population > 5 million and resident trademark application class count >= 100. Figure is a selection across regions and income groups. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collective trademark applications for the top 20 offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of collective trademark applications filed at the top 20 offices in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office and BOIP is the Benelux Office for Intellectual Property. Source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification trademark applications for the top 20 offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of certification trademark applications filed at the top 20 offices in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office and BOIP is the Benelux Office for Intellectual Property. Source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trend in trademark registrations in force worldwide, 2010–2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Time series of the number of trademark registrations in force worldwide and annual growth rates (%) from 2010 through 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 149 IP offices. Data refer to the number of trademark registrations in force, not the number of classes specified in those registrations. Trademarks can be maintained indefinitely by renewal fees. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark registrations in force for the top 20 offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of trademark registrations in force in 2021 for the top 20 offices, with growth rates (%) and office-level breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data refer to number of trademark registrations in force, not number of classes. Note: EUIPO and BOIP remarks where applicable. Source: WIPO Statistics Database.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark registrations in force in 2021 as a percentage of total registrations recorded between 1997 and 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: For each registration year between 1997 and 2021, the percentage of registrations from that year still in force in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages calculated as: number of trademark registrations issued in year t and in force in 2021 divided by total registrations issued in year t. Based on about 18.5 million active registrations reported by 74 offices that provided breakdown by year. Detailed data for some large offices not available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average age of trademarks in force at selected offices, 2016 and 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Average age (years) of trademarks in force reported by selected offices, compared between 2016 and 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BOIP is Benelux Office for Intellectual Property and EUIPO is European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of trademark examination outcomes for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Proportion (%) of examined applications with outcomes: Registered, Total rejection, Withdrawn/abandoned, for selected offices in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data via a common questionnaire and methodology; due to differences in application processing procedures across offices, data cannot be fully harmonized — exercise caution when comparing across offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potentially pending trademark applications for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of potentially pending trademark applications (applications still pending) at selected offices in 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Due to differences in application processing procedures, data cannot be fully harmonized. Detailed data for several large offices may not be available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of trademark examiners for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of trademark examiners employed by selected offices in 2021 (full-time equivalent where indicated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration of trademark examination for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Average duration (days) to first office action and to final decision for selected offices in 2021 (presented separately for first office action and final decision).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data using a common questionnaire; due to differences in procedures across offices, data cannot be fully harmonized — use caution when comparing offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party oppositions for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of third-party oppositions filed at selected offices in 2021, differentiated by pre-registration and post-registration oppositions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals against decisions for selected offices, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of appeals filed against trademark office decisions at selected offices in 2021 (office-level totals presented).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical tables: Application class count by office and origin, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed table listing application class counts by office (resident/non-resident), and application class counts by origin with changes over previous year — includes total and equivalent application class counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: (a) Data on application class count by origin are incomplete for some offices. (b)-(i) footnotes explain Madrid-only data, offices without national office, resident definitions, OAPI, territorial extensions, and other caveats. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, September 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical tables: Registration class count by office and origin, and trademarks in force, 2021
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed table listing registration class counts by office (resident/non-resident), registration class counts by origin, equivalent registration class counts by origin, and trademarks in force by office with change over previous year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes and footnotes parallel those for application class counts (coverage, Madrid-designation caveats, territorial notes). Data refer to class counts and in-force totals; some fields marked n.a. or '..' when not available.
